message: [This recipe](http://mixes.cdkitchen.com/recipes/recs/13/EthiopianBerbere70967.shtml) for berbere is really easy: put a bunch of spices together and roast in the oven at 300 degrees for 20 minutes, stirring often. I shared some of the Doro Wat over rice (the tortillas weren't such a good idea) with my attorney tonight; she enjoyed it so much she offered to pay me to set some aside for her the next time I make it. I think that's a sign it came out well. :-)
